description: Threshold response policy. Rules are checked top to bottom and the first match wins. Edit thresholds here, not in code.

rules.name: Credential lock
rules.description: Critical severity, very strong evidence and a predicted move to exfiltration or impact: lock the credentials.

rules.name: Session revoke
rules.description: Critical severity with high confidence and at least three independent indicators: revoke the session.

rules.name: Critical, evidence not enough to act
rules.description: Critical severity but the evidence does not meet the bar for an automated action: escalate to a human.

rules.name: High severity, strong evidence
rules.description: High severity with strong evidence: a human decides, nothing is automated at this level.

rules.name: Early warning
rules.description: The sequence is predicted to reach a serious stage but no action threshold is met yet: warn the operator.

default.description: No policy rule matched; recorded for the audit trail only.
